name: Exceptional IAS Academy
description: A live, production-deployed website and digital platform for a leading IAS/JKAS coaching institute. The platform serves as the institute's primary digital presence — covering UPSC and JKAS programmes, course details, results, enquiry journeys, and counselling workflows. Built with a containerized Spring Boot microservices backend deployed to a Hostinger VPS.
contribution: Designed and built the complete frontend and backend architecture from scratch. The deployment stack includes authentication, content, and learning services orchestrated via Spring Cloud Gateway and Eureka service discovery. Used PostgreSQL with Neon for persistence, Docker Compose to containerize the application, and Nginx as the public reverse proxy on a Hostinger VPS. The domain is live over HTTPS with JWT-based auth and role-based access control.
highlight: Live production URL: https://www.exceptionaliasacademy.com — This project showcases an end-to-end delivery across Next.js frontend, Spring Boot microservices, API Gateway, service discovery, PostgreSQL, Docker Compose, Nginx, DNS configuration, and HTTPS. A complete full-stack production deployment.

name: Unified Healthcare Interface (UHI)
description: A healthcare service discovery platform combining a structured Next.js frontend with an AI-assisted search layer. Built as the application context for research into reliable, constraint-aware retrieval — making it easier for users to find the right healthcare service through semantic understanding, not just keyword matching.
contribution: Built the complete Next.js frontend including structured healthcare service data, mock API layer (MSW), React Query data-fetching workflows, role-aware routing, and dashboard workflows. The application serves as both a working prototype and the test environment for the AI-assisted discovery research.
highlight: Research direction: 'Reliable AI-Assisted Healthcare Service Discovery Using Semantic Retrieval and Constraint Validation.' The study proposes comparing semantic retrieval against keyword-based search, applying deterministic validation for hard constraints, and measuring retrieval accuracy and constraint violation rates against manually labelled query sets.

name: Cloudify
description: A cloud-drive application with account-based file management, designed around a clean and intuitive user experience. The platform provides a secure sign-in gateway, account creation flow, and password recovery — enabling users to access their personal cloud storage workspace.
contribution: Designed and deployed the Cloudify application entry point, including the sign-in experience and account management flows. Focused on delivering a polished, professional authentication UX as the gateway to the cloud storage experience.
highlight: Live demo: https://cloudify-gray.vercel.app — A cloud-storage product with a clean, modern interface focused on account-based file access. The project demonstrates UI/UX design sensibility for account flows and secure application entry points.

name: Doclified
description: A document management and PDF-signing platform branded as DocSign. The application provides a complete workflow for uploading PDFs, placing signature and annotation fields, requesting signatures from other parties, downloading signed documents, and maintaining an audit history.
contribution: Built and deployed the complete Doclified/DocSign product experience, covering the full document signing workflow — PDF upload, field placement (signatures, text, dates), multi-party signature requests, and audit trail functionality.
highlight: Live demo: https://doclified.vercel.app — A digital document workflow platform. The core product direction is electronic signatures and PDF management, solving a real pain point in document-based business processes.

name: FitSpaceGym
description: A gym and fitness management web application with a dedicated API backend. The project separates the user-facing Next.js application from a Node.js/Express API with MongoDB, giving the platform a clean architecture with independent frontend and backend responsibilities.
contribution: Built both the frontend and the backend API architecture. Set up the Express/MongoDB stack, designed the database schema, implemented seed scripts for test data, and established the API contracts connecting the frontend to the backend service layer.
highlight: A practical full-stack case study demonstrating API design, database modelling, seed data management, environment configuration, and frontend/backend integration patterns. Showcases the ability to architect and build an application across the full stack independently.

name: ShoesHub
description: A modern e-commerce platform for footwear, built with a clean separation between a Next.js storefront and a NestJS API backend. The architecture provides a scalable foundation for product catalogues, user accounts, and order management.
contribution: Architected and built both the Next.js storefront and the NestJS backend service, with MongoDB as the data layer. The separation gives product presentation, API logic, and data persistence their own clear responsibilities — a maintainable, scalable e-commerce foundation.
highlight: Demonstrates a TypeScript full-stack approach using Next.js for the shopping experience and NestJS for a structured, enterprise-grade Node.js API. Showcases the ability to work across both modern frontend frameworks and structured backend architectures.

name: NexGenDevelopers
description: The website and digital identity for NexGenDevelopers — a web development studio focused on building professional websites and digital applications for clients. The brand is minimal and premium, using a black and gold visual palette that conveys craft and quality.
contribution: Built the complete studio brand — website design, frontend engineering, and brand identity. The studio site represents not just technical implementation but entrepreneurial initiative: building a professional services brand and connecting engineering capability with real-world client delivery.
highlight: Live: https://www.nexgendevelopers.in — Shows initiative beyond individual projects: building a professional studio, presenting services, and bridging engineering work with business delivery. Demonstrates the ability to own a product from concept to live deployment.
